name: Evoliz
description: Evoliz is an invoicing and management software designed for small businesses but also their accountants.

events.d: Creates a new accounting account in Evoliz for the connected company using the provided code and label.
Create a product or service article in Evoliz, including pricing, VAT, stock and supplier details.
Create a new client in Evoliz with contact, address, and optional bank and company details.
Create a new contact for an existing client in Evoliz.
Create a new contact and attach it to an existing prospect in Evoliz.
Update an existing Evoliz article's details ,  reference, description, pricing, tax and stock.
Retrieve an article's details using its unique reference code.
Retrieve clients for the authenticated Evoliz company created or updated within the last N minutes, returning the most recent results (supports pagination).
Return invoices created within the specified recent time window (last N minutes) for the authenticated company, paginated and sorted newest-first.
Retrieve payments created since the trigger's scheduled time for the connected company. Optional: filter results by payment type.
Send an invoice by email to one or more recipients, optionally attaching the PDF, adding your company signature or links, and including a custom subject and message.
